name: Tabibito Monogatari ~Journeys of Real People~
original_name: 旅人物語 ～Journeys of Real People～
source:
The protagonist, a fourth-year university student who “hasn’t found what they truly want to do,” starts working part-time at a bar where travelers gather during spring break.
Through encounters with unique travelers, they come into contact with diverse lifestyles and values—and eventually, discover their own path in life.

All three main characters are based on real Japanese people:

- Rieko Ayumi, a celebrity who has traveled to 98 countries
- A traveler who experienced a working holiday in France
- A game developer who loves traveling

By listening to their stories, what will the protagonist learn—and how will they choose to live?

[Taken from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3975150/Traveler_Stories_Journeys_of_Real_People/]Steam[/url]]
